posts.title: How far would hostile distributions go to hurt application developers?
posts.description: The Linux desktop has an upstream maintenance problem due to many reasons for it, such as the lack of paid work. No one is entitled to a volunteer's free time apart from the volunteer themself. This is especially true to volunteers working on upstream projects, as they are at the mercy of downstream distributions, who have the final say.
